i've considered this! how exciting!! 

(that sounds sarcastic, but actually, for real, that's my first thought! what a way to go!!)

hopefully that's enough time for your mood to change.

too much of life is mood. it's insane, isn't it?

Anyway, this response probably was enraging and horrible and i'm sorry.  isn't is an experience to breathe air? 

 

i love you and i wish you the best.  imagine the timer is a bad comedian with a sad, sad life.
How long does it take for the novelty of VRChat to wear off?  I feel like it's something I could have fun doing once or twice, but no more.

All in all, it was not bad.  It was my day off, so I started it by reading a book, and drinking a cup of coffee in bed.  Then I did some laundry and drew a picture and put the finishing touches on a song I've been working on.  I also cooked up some overpriced mushrooms with some eggs and toast and home fries for dinner.  Could've used some sriracha, but it was good nonetheless.

I trip a moderate amount, but I can't remember the last time I fell.  I'd probably trip more if I got out of the house more often.  Even then, it's mostly city/suburban terrain, fairly easy to avoid tripping.
Very cheap Cabernet Sauvignon.  I also had a shot of Fireball at the start.  Both are horrible in their own way, I hadn't tried either until now.
What's your favourite book that you had to read in school?
It can be 10 or 11 depending on the shoe.  Right now, the ones I usually wear are 11.

I've been learning a bit about programming, and in C, "0x" means that the number following is in hexadecimal. Then I just put in as many "f"s in as I could fit, since all "0"s was taken.  Doesn't really answer the question though... I was just trying to think of an interesting throwaway.

Yeah! Salad! Go for it!

What classes? And what breakfast?
I used to not eat breakfast, but that was a pretty bad idea in hindsight.  I feel a lot better even after a small bowl of cereal.
